value.long: Create a standalone sandbox volume bound to a concrete storage location. Available in preview builds.

VolumeName.description: Volume name, unique within the account.

volume-name.usage: Volume name, unique within the account.

AccessMode.description: Access mode: ReadWriteOnce, ReadWriteMany or ReadOnlyMany.

access-mode.usage: Access mode: ReadWriteOnce, ReadWriteMany or ReadOnlyMany.

StorageType.description: Storage backend type: Cos or Cfs. Must match the field set in the storage payload.

storage-type.usage: Storage backend type: Cos or Cfs. Must match the field set in the storage payload.

Storage.description: Concrete storage payload as JSON, @file, or - for stdin. Exactly one backend must be set and it must match --storage-type.

storage.usage: Concrete storage payload as JSON, @file, or - for stdin. Exactly one backend must be set and it must match --storage-type.
fields: Cfs: existing CFS file system path

Tags.description: Tags as a JSON array, @file, or - for stdin. The list replaces existing tags.

tags.usage: Tags as a JSON array, @file, or - for stdin. The list replaces existing tags.

StorageRoleArn.description: Role ARN used to access the underlying storage.

storage-role-arn.usage: Role ARN used to access the underlying storage.

examples:
Example - Bind an existing COS bucket path:
  agr volume create --volume-name agent-workspace --access-mode ReadWriteMany --storage-type Cos --storage '{"Cos":{"Endpoint":"cos.ap-guangzhou.myqcloud.com","BucketName":"agent-data-1250000000","BucketPath":"workspaces/agent"}}' --storage-role-arn qcs::cam::uin/100000000001:roleName/AGSCOSRole

value.long: List volumes with exact ID/name filters, generic filters and pagination. Available in preview builds.

VolumeIds.description: Volume IDs to match exactly. Repeat the flag to pass multiple values.

volume-ids.usage: Volume IDs to match exactly. Repeat the flag to pass multiple values.

VolumeNames.description: Volume names to match exactly. Repeat the flag to pass multiple values.

volume-names.usage: Volume names to match exactly. Repeat the flag to pass multiple values.

Filters.description: Generic filters as a JSON array, @file, or - for stdin. Different filters are ANDed, values inside one filter are ORed.

filters.usage: Generic filters as a JSON array, @file, or - for stdin. Different filters are ANDed, values inside one filter are ORed.
fields: Name: one of status, volume-name, volume-template-id, tag-key, tag-value, tag:<key>
Values: values ORed inside one filter

Limit.description: Number of results per page, at most 100.

limit.usage: Number of results per page, at most 100.

examples:
Example - Look up specific volumes:
  agr volume list --volume-ids vol-a1b2c3d4 --volume-ids vol-e5f6g7h8

Example - Filter by status and tag:
  agr volume list --filters '[{"Name":"status","Values":["ACTIVE"]},{"Name":"tag-key","Values":["team"]}]'

Example - Page through results:
  agr volume list --limit 20 --offset 20

value.long: Update volume tags. Storage, access mode and name cannot be changed. Identify the volume by ID or name. Available in preview builds.

VolumeId.description: Volume ID. Provide either this or --volume-name.

volume-id.usage: Volume ID. Provide either this or --volume-name.

VolumeName.description: Volume name. Provide either this or --volume-id.

volume-name.usage: Volume name. Provide either this or --volume-id.

Tags.description: Tags as a JSON array, @file, or - for stdin. The list replaces existing tags; [] clears all tags.

tags.usage: Tags as a JSON array, @file, or - for stdin. The list replaces existing tags; [] clears all tags.

examples:
Example - Replace the tag set:
  agr volume update --volume-name agent-workspace --tags '[{"Key":"team","Value":"agents"}]'

Example - Clear all tags:
  agr volume update --volume-id vol-a1b2c3d4 --tags '[]'

value.long: Delete a volume by ID or name. Deletion fails while the volume is still mounted. Available in preview builds.

VolumeId.description: Volume ID. Provide either this or --volume-name.

volume-id.usage: Volume ID. Provide either this or --volume-name.

VolumeName.description: Volume name. Provide either this or --volume-id.

volume-name.usage: Volume name. Provide either this or --volume-id.

examples:
Example - Delete by name:
  agr volume delete --volume-name agent-workspace

value.long: Create a volume template. Templates derive or reuse concrete volumes per reuse key instead of binding one fixed path. Available in preview builds.

VolumeTemplateName.description: Volume template name, unique within the account.

volume-template-name.usage: Volume template name, unique within the account.

AccessMode.description: Access mode: ReadWriteOnce, ReadWriteMany or ReadOnlyMany.

access-mode.usage: Access mode: ReadWriteOnce, ReadWriteMany or ReadOnlyMany.

ReclaimPolicy.description: Reclaim policy: Retain keeps derived volumes after the sandbox is deleted, Delete removes them.

reclaim-policy.usage: Reclaim policy: Retain keeps derived volumes after the sandbox is deleted, Delete removes them.

StorageSpec.description: Template storage spec as JSON, @file, or - for stdin. Exactly one backend must be set and it must match --storage-type.

storage-spec.usage: Template storage spec as JSON, @file, or - for stdin. Exactly one backend must be set and it must match --storage-type.
fields: Cos: COS bucket path pattern; must contain ${reuse_key}
Cfs: CFS path pattern; must contain ${reuse_key}

StorageType.description: Storage backend type: Cos or Cfs. Must match the field set in the storage payload.

storage-type.usage: Storage backend type: Cos or Cfs. Must match the field set in the storage payload.

VolumeNamePattern.description: Name pattern for derived volumes; must contain ${reuse_key}.

volume-name-pattern.usage: Name pattern for derived volumes; must contain ${reuse_key}.

DefaultCapacity.description: Reserved capacity field; ignored by the COS and CFS backends.

default-capacity.usage: Reserved capacity field; ignored by the COS and CFS backends.

StorageRoleArn.description: Role ARN used to access the underlying storage.

storage-role-arn.usage: Role ARN used to access the underlying storage.

Tags.description: Tags as a JSON array, @file, or - for stdin. The list replaces existing tags.

tags.usage: Tags as a JSON array, @file, or - for stdin. The list replaces existing tags.

examples:
Example - Derive one COS prefix per session:
  agr volume-template create --volume-template-name agent-session-workspace --access-mode ReadWriteMany --reclaim-policy Delete --storage-type Cos --storage-spec '{"Cos":{"Endpoint":"cos.ap-guangzhou.myqcloud.com","BucketName":"agent-data-1250000000","BucketPathPattern":"sessions/${reuse_key}"}}' --volume-name-pattern 'agent-workspace-${reuse_key}'
